candidates.source_name: CBCG – Zapošljavanje (Central Bank of Montenegro employment page)
candidates.why_relevant: The supervisor's own hiring page. It states CBCG advertises everything from pripravnik to managerial posts and names the exact publication channels (zzzcg.me, print, cbcg.me, prekoveze.me, CBCG social accounts) and the application mailbox posao@cbcg.me. Job titles for supervizija banaka, platni promet, sprječavanje pranja novca and instant-payments/TIPS Clone project roles are the earliest observable signal of which supervisory workstreams CBCG is staffing up for.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML fetch of the page plus the linked vacancy notices; diff on new advert titles; parse job title + organizational unit + deadline. Cross-post detection against zzzcg.me and prekoveze.me.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on regulator + job-advert glossary, then snowball to named publication channels

candidates.source_name: ZZZCG – Oglasi za slobodna radna mjesta (Montenegro Employment Agency vacancy register)

Individual adverts sit at stable per-ID URLs (e.g. /oglas/<id>/), which makes it the single highest-yield structured feed for detecting banks hiring compliance officers, AML ovlašćena lica, payment-system engineers or instant-payments project managers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of the /srm/ listing with keyword filter on a Montenegrin banking glossary (banka, platni promet, usklađenost, compliance, pranje novca, kartično poslovanje, IT bezbjednost); store per-oglas ID pages.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Montenegrin banking/payments conference brand was found — nothing equivalent to Serbia's or Croatia's recurring banking-sector conferences. Searches in Montenegrin for 'konferencija bankarstvo plaćanja Crna Gora' returned generic economic summits, the capital-market regulator's conference, and Croatian/Serbian events, not a Montenegro-specific payments conference.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments content in Montenegro appears as panels inside broader events (Adria Future Summit, Montenegro Financial Markets) or as CBCG/World Bank workshops, not as a standalone annual conference.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must target panel-level metadata inside general events plus regulator workshop announcements, rather than watching for a single sector conference calendar.

negative_findings.description: UBCG (Udruženje banaka Crne Gore) shows no published training/seminar calendar or 'bankarska akademija' equivalent to the Serbian association's Centar za bankarsku obuku, despite explicit Montenegrin-language searching for edukacija/seminari/obuke.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only 'O nama' and scattered news items were surfaced; no education section located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Association-run training is normally the richest weak signal for forthcoming rules; its apparent absence means the training signal in Montenegro must be picked up from CFA/IIRCG certification providers and CBCG workshops instead.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegrin-language training, certification or job advert was found using PSD2/PSD3 terminology ('PSD2 obuka', 'PSD2 usklađenost', 'zakon o platnom prometu edukacija'). The local vocabulary in evidence is 'platni promet', 'instant plaćanja', 'SEPA' — not the EU directive acronyms.
negative_findings.result_summary: PSD2 as a search term is unproductive for Montenegro; SEPA and instant plaćanja are the productive local terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A keyword filter built on EU directive acronyms would miss essentially all Montenegrin payment-regulation weak signals; the glossary must be built on domestic terms.

negative_findings.description: The Uprava za sprječavanje pranja novca i finansiranja terorizma (Montenegrin FIU) was referenced only indirectly; no dedicated vacancy or training page for that body was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Its adverts are presumed to run through uzk.gov.me and zzzcg.me, but this is a hypothesis, not a verified finding.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: FIU staffing is a strong AML-workload indicator; the gap should be closed before the collector is considered complete.

negative_findings.description: Career pages were confirmed only for CKB (TalentLyft ATS) and Prva banka. The remaining licensed banks (NLB Banka Podgorica, Hipotekarna banka, Erste Bank AD Podgorica, Lovćen banka, Universal Capital Bank, Adriatic Bank, Zapad banka, Addiko, Ziraat) were not individually resolved to career URLs in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-level hiring coverage is currently partial.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Instant-payments and compliance hiring at mid-sized banks is exactly the weak signal this cell exists to capture; a partial roster means systematic blind spots.

coverage_gaps.description: No per-bank career-page registry exists yet for the 11 licensed Montenegrin banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Take the UBCG member list (all 11 banks) as the authoritative roster and resolve each bank to its careers/ATS URL (many regional banks use TalentLyft, as CKB does), then register each as a monitored source.

coverage_gaps.description: Vacancy adverts are published in the daily newspaper 'Dan' on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays. Any advert that is print-only would be invisible to a web collector.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Verify whether the zzzcg.me web listing is a complete mirror of the print run; if not, arrange for an e-paper subscription or accept and document the residual blind spot.

coverage_gaps.description: There is no consolidated calendar of Montenegrin banking/payments events; agendas surface piecemeal via bankar.me, CBCG news and organiser sites, often only after the event.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a synthetic calendar by monitoring bankar.me/category/edukacija/konferencije, CBCG saopštenja, komora.me announcements, scmn.me novosti and adriafuturesummit.org; capture panel titles and speaker affiliations as the structured payload.

coverage_gaps.description: The two richest specialist-role surfaces (LinkedIn job search, Facebook vacancy groups) are auth-walled and their terms prohibit automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat these as analyst-review sources with manual saved searches; do not build scrapers. Corroborate any signal found there against an open official channel before recording it.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegrin FIU and Ministarstvo finansija training/vacancy activity is not yet resolved to specific pages, and university programmes (e.g. Ekonomski fakultet UCG) were not searched for payments/compliance specialisations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on gov.me institution subsites, uzk.gov.me filtered by issuing body, and Montenegrin university programme catalogues for new banking-supervision or payments modules.

brief: Montenegro's weak-signal layer for banking and payments is thin but unusually legible: hiring runs through a small, statutorily fixed set of channels (zzzcg.me plus print 'Dan', uzk.gov.me for state bodies, prekoveze.me and a handful of bank ATS pages), and CBCG publicly names exactly where it advertises, which makes a near-complete recruitment feed achievable. Events, by contrast, have no dedicated banking-payments conference brand — payment topics surface as panels inside broader stages (Adria Future Summit 2026 put the CBCG governor on a digital-euro/CBDC/payment-infrastructure panel; the regulator-run 'Montenegro Financial Markets' conference carried a SEPA panel as early as 2023) and as CBCG workshops with the World Bank and European Commission tied to the TIPS Clone instant-payments go-live. Training is the third strand: Ministry-licensed AML 'ovlašćeno lice' qualifications via CFA/Privredna komora and compliance/fraud certifications via IIRCG track the licensing regime closely. The decisive glossary finding is that EU directive acronyms (PSD2) return nothing locally — the productive Montenegrin terms are platni promet, instant plaćanja, SEPA, sprječavanje pranja novca, usklađenost and oglas za posao.
